book.title: Avatar Volume 1: The Last Airbender (Avatar #1)
book.description: In the perilous environment of the South Pole, a tribal village struggles to eke out its survival. When young Katara and her warrior brother Sokka rescue a young boy named Aang, they have no inkling that this mysterious stranger can save them -- and the entire world.
